rationale: The lane's CLOSED vocabulary of resolved value shapes, pinned end to end. A data language has no type system to read, so the value vocabulary IS its type contract, and leaving one member unpinned is how a placeholder string comes back: the M60 sentinel census records `return "unknown"` as this lane's one R7 violation, and the fix replaced it with `untyped`, YAML's own name for a plain scalar carrying no tag. `danglingAnchor` is the shape that produces `untyped` -- an anchor with no value -- and it is pinned with its `valueTypeSource: default`, which is what distinguishes "the grammar resolved this" from "nothing resolved it". Measured: all ten members are reachable, so the vocabulary is a contract and not an aspiration.

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
